name: Docking Suite
description: Umbrella platform for docking and molecular dynamics across diverse protein targets, preserving the peculiarities of each protein-ligand pair.
convention: A campaign is a self-contained study: it declares its own targets, ligands, pairs and protocols.
institution: Instituto Federal de Educacao, Ciencia e Tecnologia do Rio de Janeiro (IFRJ)

chemistry_defaults._note: Inherited from ESSENTIAL_COFACTORS / ESSENTIAL_METALS / REMOVE_RESIDUES in docking_v2.py. These are program-level defaults, overridden per target by target.chemistry.*. The original list was biased towards flavoenzymes (FAD/FMN/NADPH) because the platform started with a single reductase: keeping that as a DEFAULT is correct, assuming it is universal is not.
